translations.web: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.
translations.bsb: Go into the rocks and hide in the dust from the terror of the LORD and the splendor of His majesty.
translations.kjv: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
translations.asv: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty.
